title: Uncooldowned
description: Removes invulnerability ticks after damage, allowing entities to take damage every tick.
body:
- This increases combat intensity and makes fights more challenging. Perfect for PvP servers, custom mobs, and harsh gameplay mechanics. 
- Easy to integrate and lightweight for any modpack.

Made with MCreator
